newFeatures: Professional Next-Next-Next Setup Installer: Interactive NSIS installation wizard with custom destination folder, automatic migration of student data (edutrack_data & backups), and clean removal of previous versions.
Quick Student Registration in Attendance: Instantly register and enroll a new student directly from the attendance session page without losing your workflow.
Group Mismatch Alert in Attendance: Displays a clear warning dialog if a student being checked in belongs to a different group than the active session.
Late Mode Check-in Rule: Toggling 'Late Mode' marks only future incoming attendees as late during the active session, leaving already-attended students unaffected.
Session Financial Properties: View detailed money flow per session — including who attended with a discount, the center's revenue percentage, and the exact amount owed per student.
Individual WhatsApp Messaging: Send personalized WhatsApp messages to individual students directly from their profile.
improvements: Seamless Data Migration: Zero data loss during app updates — databases, config, and backups automatically transfer to new install directories.
Enhanced Attendance Verification: Real-time confirmation prevents accidental cross-group attendance entries.
Auto-Block Invalid Parent Phones: Automatically blocks WhatsApp numbers that are formatted improperly or lack WhatsApp accounts.
Message Status Live Update: Delivery status now refreshes in real-time without needing page reloads.
bugFixes: Fixed Late Mode applying retrospectively to already attended students.
Fixed WhatsApp message status not refreshing automatically after sending.
Fixed edge cases where inactive student auto-blocking could conflict with manual block operations.
Fixed session financial calculations when discount overrides are applied mid-session.
